notes: Original F CROSS_RX50, RDrop1/LS.01/ordinaryAug/oldgate-ownEMA-cos/unifiedSinc/defaultheadjoint, scratch50=33L+17U/11100updates. Local GPU0 max3 global workers incl otherowners/RAM>=4.5GiB; oneCPUscorer; no satellite/clean168000 only.

Source design evidence: threefixedBASE sourceV caches, no new model forward, target or Utruth. Weakpair crossRX direction ranks3/1/9 not consistent; not selecting a pure orientation-alignment hypothesis. Weakpair sameRX gaps atRX3 .235-.264 andRX8 .287-.290 consistently smaller thanRX6 .472-.540. Fixed margin.4 chosen from this source geometry before newtarget.

Use original two stochastic L128 RDrop forward joint160, normalize eachview perpacket then average; partition distinct physicalpackets inside each weakTX andsourceRX/day alternately intoA/B, eachclass>=2. Views ofsameIQ are never statistical halves. Otherclass packets remain in original main loss/SupCon; no classCE weights changed.

SELF estimate .5*(||deltaA||²+||deltaB||²); CROSS signed deltaA dot deltaB. Difference equals .5||deltaA-deltaB||². Same normalizedhinge max(0,.16-estimate)/.16, mean eligible cells, warm5/ramp10/max.1 everyLstep9990. No clipping signedcross statistic; no assumption of independentIID finitepool halves or unbiasedness.

Geometric loss acts on actualdeployedfeature, not a fitted or exported prototypeclassifier. Default head allparameters normal mainjoint, auxiliarydirectgradient absent. Gradient travels through Sinc/shallow/middle; no extra parameter/forward/read/update. Original physicalSinc optimizer/cosine/clip5/ownEMA executes once from total main+aux gradients. Auxiliary-only same-valued joint reconstructed from captured norm inputs/reference/sequence outputs with detached entire cls_head norm/gain; original output/main joint unchanged. Two extra functionalLayerNorm perview tensor algebra, no model forward.
Same coefficient/cells/views/cost across arms, but different estimators change loss/gradient magnitudes; difference cannot be attributed solely to de-noising independent of objective strength.

Source expansion fixed before newtarget: eachweak outRXmarginq10>=sameBASE+.002, RXspread/interTXgap<=1.05, zero features0; defaulthead overall>=-.2pp,worstRX>=-.5pp,anyTX>=-1pp;9990scheduled,eligible>=85%,activehinge>=10%,all15RXday cells at least20uses. Only qualified arm extends unchanged02/03. Source failure initial rows still clean-score.

SourceV defaulthead health plus descriptivegeometry, all five sourceRX seen; outRX centroids not unknownRX classification. No fitted head/prototype decisions. Reuse matching original3BASE source/scores, no duplicate training/testing. RealBASEcheckpoint only one discarded CPU noquery smoke, not initialization.

CPU/CUDA actualF checks passed; eachdevice2 discarded syntheticnative steps, defaulthead joint andphysicalSinc updated; no realIQ/formaltraining/target. One realcheckpoint noquery CPU smoke passed anddiscarded. Source/config/hiddenlabel/physicalID/math negatives passed. Unique independent P0/P1 PASS; fullhead P1 caught beforelaunch, auxiliary-only fix CPU/CUDA PASS, targeted issue-only review PASS.
Primary mean-embedding background https://jmlr.org/papers/v13/gretton12a.html. This is supervised feature separation penalty, not a full MMD test, statistical significance claim or guaranteed gain.
